notes.js: Browser, Node.js, Deno, and Bun. Other package managers and the CDN build are covered in the guide.
notes.python: CPython 3.10+ on Linux x86_64 or macOS arm64. The wheel also installs the suzume command.
notes.go: Go 1.26+ with cgo. Build the C library first, then point your module at the checkout.
notes.cpp: Installs the library and headers into /usr/local. Set PREFIX to install elsewhere.

client.title: Client-side and synchronous
client.desc: Runs in the browser or inside your own process, and analyze() returns synchronously. Input text never leaves the device, and there is no tokenization server, network round trip, or CORS setup.

unknown.title: Robust to unknown words
unknown.desc: Combines compact dictionaries with character and grammar patterns to handle words without a dictionary entry.

userDict.title: Runtime user dictionary
userDict.desc: Load product names and domain terms from a TSV string at runtime. No rebuild and no dictionary compiler; clearUserDictionaries() removes them again.

comparison.title: Where Suzume fits
comparison.subtitle: More detail than a plain word segmenter, a fraction of the size of a dictionary-based analyzer. Suzume sits between them.
comparison.guideTitle: There is more to the difference than this table
comparison.guideDescription: See concrete examples of token boundaries, dictionary dependence, and unknown-word handling.
comparison.perfDescription: Per-call latency, initialization cost, and what the accuracy figures do and do not cover.

useCase.title: Try it on your own text
useCase.tagDesc: Generate hashtags from blog posts or product descriptions.
useCase.excludeBasicTip: Filters out common verbs with hiragana-only lemma (する, いる, ある...)
useCase.baseDesc: Reduce verbs and adjectives to their base form for search indexing.
useCase.analyzeDesc: Split Japanese text into tokens with POS and lemma.

typewriter.title: Tokenized as you read
typewriter.source: From "I Am a Cat" by Natsume Soseki
